title: 第152章 R派和六派
slug: 综艺大导演从齐聚初代跑男开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“艺心说的对，洪雷哥这太吓人了，哪像霸道总裁啊，简直就是混世魔王。”

王讯在一旁系着领带，总是感觉不舒服，“这领带太紧了，勒得我喘不过气，洪雷哥快点帮我松一下！”

“你才是混世魔王，我是绝世帅雷雷！”

孙洪雷不耐烦的帮王讯扯着领带，“我看你是最近吃多了！整天说什么，跟着讯哥走，美食美景全都有，有什么有？”

就在众人说笑的时候，迪丽热八从化妆间走了出来。

今天的热八，被划分到了男人帮的阵容。

这一瞬间整个房间安静了。

黑色西装裙，收腰设计，长发微卷披在肩上，妆容清透。

眼神里带着一丝冷艳。

她踩着高跟鞋走到镜子前，微微歪头，嘴角轻轻一勾。

孙洪雷笑道：“八八今天好漂亮……”

“洪雷哥别闹，还是叫我热八吧，不然感觉很奇怪哦！”迪丽热八转头看孙洪雷笑道，“不过洪雷哥今天也很帅！”

紧随其后，鹿寒也走了出来。

今天他和迪丽热八一起加入了男人帮阵营。

毕竟为了平衡阵容人数，形成8V8，他和热八一起来是最合适的。

因为这里还有一个他曾经在同个组合的好兄弟。

鹿寒此刻穿着修身的黑色西装，领口别着一枚精致的胸针，整个人清冷又矜贵。

像是那种出身豪门的少爷。

他完全符合这个气质。

张艺兴笑道：“鹿哥帅爆了！”

鹿寒和张艺兴站在一起。

EXO的归国四子之二又罕见的合体了。

帅哥美女相聚一堂。

又好看又养眼。

吴凡的声音恰好传出：“所有人大厅集合！”

跑男团和男人帮来到大厅后。

大厅灯光全部突然暗了下来。

所有人站在宽敞到可以开舞会的大厅里面面相觑。

大厅的尽头站着两个人。

正是王征羽和严抿。

水晶吊灯发出柔和的光芒，将每个人的影子拉得很长。

忽然大门被猛地推开！

一个人跌跌撞撞地冲了进来，脸色煞白，满头大汗，声音都在发抖：“不……不好了！董事长病危了！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Yi Xin is right. Brother Hong Lei is too scary. He doesn't look like a domineering president. He is simply a demon king."

Wang Xun was tying his tie on the side, but he always felt uncomfortable. "This tie is too tight. It makes me breathless. Brother Hong Lei, help me loosen it quickly!"

"You are the Demon King, and I am Lei Lei, the peerless handsome man!"

Sun Honglei impatiently helped Wang Xun pull his tie, "I think you have eaten too much recently! What can you say all day long? Follow Brother Xun. You can have all the delicious food and beautiful scenery. What do you have?"

While everyone was talking and laughing, Dilireba walked out of the dressing room.

Today's Reba was classified into the Men's Gang lineup.

At this moment the whole room was quiet.

Wearing a black suit skirt with a waist design, her long hair is slightly curled and draped over her shoulders, and her makeup is clear.

There was a hint of coldness in his eyes.

She walked to the mirror in high heels, tilted her head slightly, and curled the corners of her mouth slightly.

Sun Honglei smiled and said: "Baba is so beautiful today..."

"Brother Honglei, don't make trouble. You should call me Reba, otherwise it will feel weird!" Dili Reba turned to look at Sun Honglei and smiled, "But Brother Honglei is also very handsome today!"

Immediately after, Lu Han also walked out.

Today he and Di Lieba joined the men's gang camp.

After all, in order to balance the lineup and form 8V8, it is most suitable for him to join Reba.

Because there is also a good brother here who was in the same group.

Lu Han was wearing a slim-fitting black suit at the moment, with a delicate brooch pinned to his collar. He looked cold and noble.

Like the kind of young master who comes from a wealthy family.

He fits this temperament perfectly.

Zhang Yixing smiled and said: "Brother Lu is so handsome!"

Lu Han and Zhang Yixing stood together.

The two of EXO's four returning sons have reunited in a rare reunion.

Handsome guys and beauties gather together.

Beautiful and eye-catching.

Wu Fan's voice came out just in time: "Everyone gather in the lobby!"

After the men's running team and the men's gang came to the hall.

All the lights in the hall suddenly dimmed.

Everyone stood in the hall, which was spacious enough for a dance party, and looked at each other.

Two people stood at the end of the hall.

It was Wang Zhengyu and Yan Xi.

The crystal chandelier emits soft light, lengthening everyone's shadow.

Suddenly the door was pushed open!

A man stumbled in, his face was pale, he was sweating profusely, and his voice was trembling: "No...it's not good! The chairman is critically ill!"
